name: Bourke Post Office
scope: The standing 1880 Bourke Post Office with its second storey, filigree verandah and early twentieth-century entrance lobby.
era: Standing historic post office, including the 1889 storey and the entrance lobby completed by 1901.

externalReferences.artist: Government Architect's Office, New South Wales (album creator)

originalReview.notes: The original 842 by 638 state archive upload is marked No known copyright restrictions. The archive dates the Government Architect’s album to circa 1880–1940. The second storey and the absence of the front lobby fit the 1889–1901 configuration. Photographer uncredited.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Checked published Qualla imagery first. The post office photos are CC BY-SA. Used the NSW State Archives exact original from the Government Architect’s album. Used heritage facts and cadastral map data for later alterations.
